[size=3][font=Verdana][color=#f6b26b]---------------------------------------------------------------[/color]
[color=#f6b26b]Journey to 5.0.0[/color]
[color=#f6b26b]---------------------------------------------------------------[/color][/font]

June 2026: The Rite of Stars content for the 4.5 beta will be uploaded to stardewvalley.net around the 14th of June (Originally planned for late April/early May, but there's been a lot of rework)

The mod is currently being rebuilt. These are some of the biggest changes to the mod:

More ways to engage with creatures and NPCs with a unique dialogue system that enables trade and conversation.
New rites and rite effects, including passive/map-wide effects.
A comprehensive skills system, with 80 masteries to choose and many ways to earn experience.
An expanded alchemy and crafting system based on 36 unique items.
A vastly improved distillery and monster taming system.[/size]
[size=3]A complete overhaul of spritework, animations, companions, sound effects and location designs.[/size]
[size=3]A finished storyline.[font=Verdana]

[url=https://forums.stardewvalley.net/resources/stardew-druid.139/]Beta Version 4.5.1[/url] is now available on stardewvalley.net. This version is complete up to the end of Rite of Mists.[/font]

Thank you to everyone who has maintained interest in the mod since it's early days as a simple magic system. Please track the mod so that you're notified when 5.0.0 releases, for what will be the definitive adventure experience for Stardew Valley.[font=Verdana]

[color=#f6b26b]====================================[/color]
[color=#f6b26b]Stardew Druid[/color]
[color=#f6b26b]====================================[/color][/font]

Stardew Druid is a unique kind of expansion created to satisfy a desire for adventure. 

50+ quests with one every day, following a special story inspired by mythology. The worldbuilding is vanilla-adjacent and lore-friendly.
25+ abilities with over 100 effects and interactions, all with unique animations.
6 unique NPCs with 20+ supporting NPCs.
15 recruitable companions using an advanced follower system.
10 custom locations with unique 16bit assets.
20+ unique monsters and foes, coded from scratch, with 5 that can be captured, trained and used for friendly battles!
100+ collectables that won't cramp your inventory, as they are accessed in bespoke menus.
5000+ lines of dialogue and lore, including unique reactions from vanilla villagers to your actions.

This mod provides an alternative to early tool-based gameplay in the form of six schools of magic, which incorporate motifs and themes inspired by the Druids of antiquity!

The expansive questline starts with a custom NPC, the Effigy, who can be found in the druid cave extension, which is inserted between the farm and the farmcave. 

The Effigy will initially offer a new lesson or quest each day. The mod includes over ten epic boss battles to test your skills, with a range of configuration options to suit your playstyle. There are 25 lessons in total. 

Your journey is recorded in the Stardew Druid journal, a custom journal menu that provides all the instruction and lore you could ask for. 

For those seeking an alternative Community Center completion strategy, Stardew Druid offers six optional quests to complete each section of the center (leading to the restored center ending).

For any mod support, discussion, translation queries or feedback we recommend you join us on [url=https://discord.gg/XK29PHPqSg]Stardew Druid Discord[/url] as opposed to posting on Nexus. Depending on timezones you might be able to get a response in under a minute!

==========================================
SETUP | COMPATIBILITY
==========================================

Only requires SMAPI

[color=#ff7700]At the moment this mod is not compatible with Android SMAPI[/color]

Compatible with all other mods including popular expansions such as Stardew Valley Expanded, Baldur's Village, Alchemistry. If there is a mod compatibility issue, come onto discord and log a ticket!

Stable for remote multiplayer games (Splitscreen is not supported at this time).

Compatible with controllers/gamepads.

i18n Format implemented.

Generic Mod Configuration Menu implemented to easily change the configuration settings.

Custom data model stored in save files - only affects the mod, so won't impact any save files after uninstalling/installing.

Enable and Disable the mod with confidence on any of your save files at any season/year of your playthrough.

Some modded farm maps start with locked or obscured farmcave locations. This mod provides a relic, Grandpa's Whetstone, in the reliquary (keybind I) that when used (hotkey keybind P) will warp your farmer to the Druid Grove and when used there, will warp your farmer back to the farmhouse. This will enable you to access the farmcave extension (entrance at bottom of the Grove) and start your journey straight away.

==========================================
Casting System
==========================================

The mod works primarily though the use of the 'rite button', which is by default configured to keyboard V, mouse button 4, mouse button 5 and controller LeftShoulder.

Any of the main line of vanilla tools (Pickaxe, Axe, Hoe, WateringCan etc) or any Melee Weapon (Including Scythe) must be selected in toolbar to perform a rite (cast).

There are two possible methods for selecting a rite to use.

The default is normal attunement, where the rite you have selected is based on what is attuned to the weapon or tool you are holding. Some weapons have fixed attunement to a rite, for instance the forest sword always casts Weald. More weapons/tools can be attuned to Weald by talking to the standing stones in the druid grove while the tool/weapon you want to attune is selected in your inventory. All unattuned weapons will cast the last rite unlocked in your progression as a default.

An attuned weapon will be provided for every rite learnt. Patrons will be encountered throughout the storyline that provide additional attunement options

The second method for rite selection is slot attunement, which can be enabled in the configuration. This will fix the slots to use to slot 1 - 6 in the inventory, so no matter what weapon or tool is in slot 1, it will always cast Weald.

[color=#93c47d]-----------------------------------------
1. Rite of the Weald
-----------------------------------------
Weald is an old fashioned name for a woodland area, where ancient druids would perform ceremonies honouring the kings of Oak and Holly. This rite is about rewilding the empty spaces of the Valley and drawing on the life essence of the Earth.[/color]

Draw out the hidden bounty of the valley, add trees and grass to barren spaces, enhance the growth rate of crops, explode weeds, twigs, ore veins and trigger rock falls in the mines.

[color=#9fc5e8]-----------------------------------------
2. Rite of Mists
-----------------------------------------
The isle of mists is an important place in medieval sagas, and the residence of the Lady Beyond the Shore. This rite is about being a commanding presence with awesome displays of power and lots of lightning bolts.[/color]

Extract power from totem shrines, target scarecrows, rods and campfires for special functions, create high-yield fishing spots, and smite any obstacle in your way. 

[color=#dd7e6b]-----------------------------------------
3. Rite of the Stars 
-----------------------------------------
Celestial bodies and formations were an important device of storytelling and calendar traditions. That's all very wonderful and this rite is about calling down little stars as fireballs.[/color]

Call a meteor shower and rain down fire from the sky with reckless abandon, or create an anomaly in space-time with a gravity well that pulls in crops and enemies.

[color=#8e7cc3]-----------------------------------------
4. Rite of the Fates
-----------------------------------------
The fates are mentioned in many traditions of cultures that were adjacent to or inspired by the Fates of Greek mythology, and are the etymological root for faeries, fae and the like. This rite is about chance and destiny intertwined to produce random effects.[/color]

Meddle with the powers of the Fates to warp travel, curse enemies, impress villagers with magic tricks and enchant farm machines.

[color=#c27ba0]-----------------------------------------
5. Rite of Ether
----------------------------------------
The fifth element, ether, which inspires a lot of alchemical traditions, is considered to incorporate both the spiritual/divine and the material. The traditional progenitors and agents of this element were... Dragons.[/color]

Transform into a Dragon!

[color=#a2c4c9]-----------------------------------------
6. Rite of Bones
----------------------------------------
The Corvidae family of birds are often used as a motif in old superstitions, in which they are likely depicted as manifestations of close familial bonds between mortals and otherworldly spirits.[/color]

Summon four corvid familiars to assist you

[color=#fff2cc]-----------------------------------------
7. The Final Rite
-----------------------------------------
Druid societies gained strength and resilience by developing their own traditions of migration, commerce and agriculture. The final rite is about using the abilities you've gained to serve the valley.[/color]

Recruit villagers to your band of adventurers, strengthen bonds with economic guilds and tame the wild monsters of the valley!
[color=#f6b26b]
-----------------------------------------
+ Additional Features
-----------------------------------------[/color]

Gently caress your farm animals and neighbours with magic for soft friendship points each day.

Prove yourself in new, unique challenges that test your ability with each rite.

Encounter customised creatures with enhanced stats, cosmetics and behaviour.

Boost your output with the specialised herbalism feature, unique to Stardew Druid!

Throw bombs from your inventory by selecting them and using the rite button. Further augmentation is available with herbalism.

Gain a dungeon delving companion, a treasure hunting friend and a gardener for your farm.

Tame monsters using a unique capture system and use their unique abilities in monster battles!

Explore the opportunities of a bespoke economic system that involves making large shipments of goods on an open market.

Gather alchemical components from monsters and friendly creatures, and consume them to boost the quality of your items.

-----------------------------------------------------------
THE 'DRUID' ROUTE (ALTERNATIVE CC COMPLETION)
-----------------------------------------------------------
Each room in the community center can be repaired by searching for and completing a series of relics.

1. Craftroom - Druid Runestones (Requires Rite of Stars)
Defeat bosses in epic challenge events to reclaim the runestones of the old circle

2. Boiler - Shadow Gear
Search for equipment used by a mysterious group of shadowfolk marauders

3. Fishtank - The Avalant (Requires Rite of Mists)
Search for the scattered pieces of an ancient and powerful device

4. Vault - Pilgrim Tokens (Requires Rite of Stars)
Restore the sacred spaces of the valley to earn tokens

5. Bulletin - Memento Boxes (Requires Rite of Ether)
Impress the Fates with your industriousness as a farmer, by unlocking the skull caverns, forging an iridium tool, building a deluxe animal house and more.

6. Pantry - Ancient Texts (Requires Rite of Ether)
Search for treasure caches throughout the valley that may contain testimonies and other writings left behind by the forebearers of the circle of druids.

Note: To start the druid route, the community center must be unlocked. For each quest the junimo plaque / bundle instructions must be present in the room you wish to complete. For instance, for the boiler room to unlock minecarts, at least two bundles need to be completed (I recommend the spring forage and construction bundle in the craftroom as they are particularly easy to do early).

Also! You can still claim ALL the bundle rewards from the 'missing rewards pouch' that appears next to the junimo hut on the left side of the fireplace in the center

-----------------------------------------
CONFIG FILE
-----------------------------------------

Rite Buttons "riteButtons" is a list of keybinds set to MouseX1, MouseX2, Keyboard.V and LeftShoulder
Action Buttons "actionButtons" is a list of keybinds set to MouseLeft, ControllerX and Keyboard.C
Special Buttons "specialButtons" is a list of keybinds set to MouseRight, ControllerY and Keyboard.X
Channel Buttons "channelButtons" is a list of keybinds set to LeftShift, RightShift

This OPTIONAL configuration does not override or edit in-game keybinds for the action controls, instead it just enables the mod to detect when the action/use tool button has been pressed. This is useful in the case that the action button is mapped to a non-conventional input, such as a special button on non-standard controllers or gaming mice. Rite button is the main keybind for the mod, and the mod will not function effectively without it. Some Rites have additional effects that can be triggered by 'channelling' the rite under certain conditions, the Force Channel button can force the mod to ignore these conditions.

-----------------------------------------
Journal Button is a list of keybinds set to K
Effects button is a list of keybinds set to L
Relics Button is a list of keybinds set to I
Herbalism Button is a list of keybinds set to O
Warp Button is a list of keybinds set to P

These OPTIONAL configurations will open the Stardew Druid journal from the game world. Warp will attempt to utilise any 'wayfinder' relics that the player possesses that are associated with the current map. It can be used from the very start of the mod to trigger the Whetstone Relic to warp from the farm/farmhouse directly to the grove and back.

-----------------------------------------
Sort Journal by Active "activeJournal"
Reverse Journal "reverseJournal"

Sort and reverse the order in which Stardew Druid journal entries are displayed. Default: oldest to newest. Enabled: newest to oldest.

-----------------------------------------
Dialogue Display "dialogueOption"
Caption Display "captionOption"

These values determine how dialogue is rendered in Stardew Druid events. Stardew Druid does not pause time or disable player control during events, this is primarily to enable the player to interact with the environment freely, especially during combat challenges. In this regard, NPC dialogue is presented as overhead-text and as captions, of which the size and format can be adjusted with these settings.

-----------------------------------------
Mod Difficulty (modDifficulty)

Determines how hard or easy the mod will be. Mod Difficulty affects stamina costs, potion replenishment, custom monster strength and monetary rewards.

Cali:

Monster Difficulty - 66%
Quest Rewards + 66%
Potion Replenishment + 40%
Stars: Gravity Well has extra chance for iridium crop and fish harvest
Stars: Gravity Well guardian serpents are disabled

Easy:
Stamina Costs - 33%
Monster Difficulty - 33%
Quest Rewards + 33%
Potion Replenishment + 20%

Medium:
Stamina Costs ~
Monster Difficulty ~
Quest Rewards ~
Potion Replenishment ~

Hard:

----------------------------------------- 
Set Milestone Progress "setMilestone"
Set Once "setOnce"
Auto Progress "autoProgress"
Pace of Progress "paceProgress"

Can be used to override the mod state on game load. 0 is the default for no effective change. See the progress list above. Set once will ensure that the value is set back to 0 to prevent any overridden states for other saves. Auto progress will load the next lesson/quest at the start of each in game day, without the need to approach any of the quest NPCs. Pace Of Progress can be used to increase the number of days that elapses between lessons or quests (suitable for stretching progress over a year or two years).

-----------------------------------------
Slot Attune "slotAttune"
Slot Freedom "slotFreedom" (requires Slot Attunement)
Slot Consume "slotConsume"
Slot Reverse "slotReverse"
Potion Defaults "potionDefault"
Slots 1 - 12

Can be used to configure whether to fix attunement to certain slots in the inventory and whether to auto-consume edible items. Can be further configured with slot freedom to enable any item to be held to cast, and slot reverse which consumes edibles from left to right instead of right to left. In addition, the slots themselves can be re-registered. Further consumption options are available for individual potions and powders, potion defaults will determine what the default setting will be.

-----------------------------------------
Cultivate Behaviour "cultivateBehaviour"
Adjusts the speed vs quality setting for RotW: Cultivate behaviour. 

1. Prioritises speed, with enhanced growth rate and speed fertiliser, and chance for extra harvest with RotF: Gravity Well
2. Balanced between speed and quality
3. Prioritises quality, with quality fertiliser and better chance for quality harvest when harvested with RotF: Gravity Well
4. 'Ridiculous' boosts to speed and quality

Cultivate Plot Size "cultivatePlot"
Choose the patch size for crops when converting wild seeds with Weald:Cultivate. 
For instance, size 3 will indicate to the mod to attempt to seed the same crop within a 3x3 square.

Cultivate Tall Crops "cultivateTallCrops"
Choose whether to allow cultivation of trellis crops and scythable crops when converting wild seeds with Weald:Cultivate.

-----------------------------------------
Meteor Behaviour "meteorBehaviour"
Adjust the risk/reward setting that governs RotS: Meteor behaviour, including targetting, damage and coverage.

1. Prioritises Monsters and Stone Nodes. Otherwise uses a regular spatial pattern for optimal coverage. Normal damage.
2. Prioritises Monsters, otherwise uses a spatial pattern, 1.1x damage
3. Prioritises Stone Nodes, otherwise uses a spatial pattern, 1.1x damage (default)
4. Uses a spatial pattern only, 1.25x damage, 33% chance for large meteor
5. Completely random coverage, 1.6x damage, 50% chance for large meteor

-----------------------------------------
Maximum Damage "maximumDamage"
Some spell effects have damage modifiers that consider player skill levels, druid level (mod progress) and applied enchantments.
Enable to apply max damage everytime. The damage shown is roughly the amount applied to monster health by one Stars:Meteor hit.

Maximum Damage (when enabled)
= 250

Calculated damage (when disabled, default)
5 * Combat Level    ~ 50 at end game
+ 2 * Mining Level    ~ 20 at end game
+ 2 * Foraging Level  ~ 20 at end game
+ Farming Level   ~ 10 at end game
+ Fishing Level   ~ 10 at end game
+ 3 * SD Druid Progress level ~ 120 at end
+ 25 if selected tool is enchanted
+ 25 for Fighter Profession
+ 25 for Brute Profession
= ~250-300 at end game, with more or less depending on Levels and SD Druid Progress

Cardinal Targetting
Disables isometric (6 way) targetting for transformation effects. Might look a little misaligned with the transformation animations."
